data.body:
Observed AGAIN 2026-08-21, during unrelated work (f1bc outbound_differ split). New details beyond the description:

- Reproduced on a DIFFERENT base sha than the ticket records: the description cites failure at pristine main 6fb4d801c9; this observation is on origin/main e016c152794b (post-S2 438a merge), in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/impl-mapping-seam. Confirms the failure is base-independent / environmental, not tied to a specific main revision.
- Interpreter: cpython-3.12.13-macos-aarch64 (uv-managed .venv), macOS (APFS temp dir /private/var/folders/...).
- This run's exact failure: git -C <tmp>/pytest-19493/test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_t0/bare.git cat-file -t 1d849b8b8c00f78552f75b68c66ed3a9eac20bdb returned exit 128 (object absent from the bare remote after push) — same mechanism as described, fresh SHA/tmp path each run.
- Blast radius confirmed isolated: pytest -x stopped ONLY at this test (1764 passed before it); deselecting just this one test → 3036 passed, 1 deselected across tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py + tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/. No collateral failures, so the standing 'ignore only this test' guidance remains safe.
- Still deterministic in this env (fails every run). No retry/skip applied — deselected only for local validation of the unrelated refactor, per the ignore-this-one guidance.
